Final reportA new transition has been studied in synthetics. The real search was not launched due to the cost of 2^518 supplements. This is a limitation of the method, not an exception of the model.

Fully local series; standard library Python 3.11, single-handed CPU, without GPU, installations and re-execution of previous searches routine secp256k1; mask - junior i−1 bits of state 83 decision-making copied without alteration from the accepted SEQ-05.

Teams from the project root in PowerShell:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

verify.py The rest of the teams, if they have results They pass the already completed stages and add only the excluded ones manifesto JOURNAL.jsonlDo integrity checks first. Received files for the new calculation should not be deleted: the new series must have separate folder and staging.

  • PROTOCOL.md: predefined model, example classes and limitations.
  • core.pyarithmetic PGL, Interpolation, the exact listing of additions.
  • study.py: data creation, initial binding and frozen parameters.
  • execute.py: accepted binding based on outcome model_budget; explanation EXECUTION_NOTE.md.
  • controls/*.json:all 50 Control packages, including uncompleted ones.
  • CONTROLS.json: summary; 24 Expanded full-size examples restored Undoubtedly, the original full-size data form did not pass the tolerance.
  • REAL_PREFLIGHT.json: the exact size of the actual search, no search.
  • PREFLIGHT_DETAIL.jsonGeneral residues of supports and boundaries of interpretation of value.
  • audit.py, AUDIT.json, TINY_EXHAUSTIVE.json: independent checks.
  • PRIOR_SNAPSHOT.json: SHA256 and mtime 637 received previous files.
  • MANIFEST.json, EXECUTION_MANIFEST.json: frozen entrances and code.
  • ACCEPTANCE.json, COMPLETE.json, ARTIFACTS.json: acceptance and integrity.

Do not interpret zero of the listed real states as an absence Compatible models. search_result=null It means there was no search.
